comment: Client-side authorization / permission logic locators (0.47.0). Scanned against JS bodies only. Passive: flags where the UI makes access decisions in the browser; the 'note' says how to abuse it. Bounded spans (ReDoS). Reported non-sensitive.

patterns.name: Client-side admin/role check
patterns.note: authorization decided in the browser -- call the gated endpoint directly with a low-priv/no session; UI hiding is not a server-side control

patterns.name: Role equality comparison
patterns.note: flip this role in storage/response and re-request, and test the privileged action's API directly to see if the server actually enforces it

patterns.name: Route/auth guard
patterns.note: the guarded route's backing API is the real target -- request it without going through the guard

patterns.name: Client-side permission list
patterns.note: enumerate the full permission/role vocabulary here, then try values the current user shouldn't have

patterns.name: Admin UI gating flag
patterns.note: set this flag true (console/response tamper) to reveal hidden admin UI, then confirm the backing endpoints aren't server-side protected
